title: Up, Up and Away
intro: [excited] Fasten your seatbelts and return your tray tables to their upright position! Tonight we're flying with balloons, big ears, pixie dust and hang gliders. [laughs] Up, up and away!

art.prompt: A dreamy sky full of drifting clouds at golden hour, a colorful cluster of balloons, a vintage biplane, a flying umbrella and a hang glider soaring above a patchwork of distant lands Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Adventure Is Out There
categories.intro: Our film category is Pixar's Up! [chuckles] Grab your grape soda badge.

art.prompt: A cozy old wooden house floating high above jagged green table-top mountains and a misty waterfall, a giant blimp drifting in the distance Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Up, Wilderness Explorer Russell needs one last badge, for doing this, before he can become a Senior Wilderness Explorer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is assisting the elderly! [laughs] Lucky for Russell, Carl was right on the porch.

clues.clue: Carl's childhood hero, explorer Charles Muntz, travels the world in this giant airship.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Spirit of Adventure! [gasps] Full of dogs, and a very grumpy captain.

clues.clue: Young Ellie makes Carl an honorary member of her club with a badge made from the cap of this drink.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is grape soda! [sighs] Carl pins it on Russell at the end. Tissues, anyone?

clues.clue: In 2009, Up became the first animated film ever to open this famous film festival.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Cannes Film Festival! Carl Fredricksen on the French Riviera. [laughs] He probably complained about the noise.

clues.clue: This 2023 Pixar short shows a nervous Carl getting ready for his first date in years, with help from Dug.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Carl's Date! It played in theaters before Elemental. Ed Asner's last time voicing Carl.

categories.title: Wings and Things
categories.intro: Our themed category: how Disney characters take flight. [excited] Wheee!

art.prompt: A whimsical sky scene with a circus tent far below, a single black feather floating upward, a little crop-duster airplane and a vintage seaplane cruising past fluffy clouds Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Dumbo learns to fly by flapping these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his ears! [laughs] Big ears, big dreams.

clues.clue: The magic feather that helps Dumbo believe he can fly comes from this flock of birds.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is crows! Then Dumbo finds out the magic was in him all along.

clues.clue: To fly to Neverland, it's second star to the right and straight on till this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is morning! [whispers] Think happy thoughts.

clues.clue: In the 2013 film Planes, Dusty Crophopper is this kind of plane who dreams of air racing.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a crop duster! He's afraid of heights, which is a real problem for a plane.

clues.clue: In the cartoon series TaleSpin, Baloo flies cargo in this seaplane.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sea Duck! [excited] Kit Cloudkicker surfs behind it on his airfoil board.

categories.title: Soar Spot
categories.intro: Our Parks category: attractions that take you flying. [laughs] Please keep your feet dangling.

art.prompt: A giant concave dome screen showing a sweeping aerial view of mountains, rows of suspended seats lifted into the air, gondola cabins gliding past on cables outside Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: On this EPCOT attraction, you hang-glide above famous landmarks around the globe.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Soarin' Around the World! [whispers] Breathe deep. Some scenes come with smells.

clues.clue: This gondola system, which opened in 2019, links EPCOT and Disney's Hollywood Studios with several resorts.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Disney Skyliner! [excited] A flying cabin, with air conditioning.

clues.clue: Soarin' first took flight in 2001 as Soarin' Over California at this park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! The ride came to EPCOT four years later, in 2005.

clues.clue: During the original Soarin' Over California, guests smelled the blossoms of this fruit as they flew over a grove.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is oranges! [laughs] Orange County, orange groves, orange you glad you got that?

clues.clue: This spinning Magic Kingdom ride sends rockets whirling high above Tomorrowland, on top of the PeopleMover station.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Astro Orbiter! You ride an elevator just to get to the launch pad.

categories.title: Up in the Air
categories.intro: Our fan category: flying, Disney style. [chuckles] Name it before it lands.

art.prompt: A collection of flying objects tumbling through a starry night sky: an open umbrella, a brass bed with bedknobs, a jetpack trailing flame, and a glowing green dragon tail shimmer Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins floats down to Cherry Tree Lane holding this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an umbrella! [laughs] And hers has a talking parrot head handle.

clues.clue: Woody insists Buzz isn't flying, he's just doing this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is falling with style! [chuckles] Woody, buddy, it still counts.

clues.clue: In Bedknobs and Broomsticks, a magic spell on an enchanted knob lets this piece of furniture fly.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bed! It even visits the bottom of the sea and an island full of animals.

clues.clue: In The Rocketeer, stunt pilot Cliff Secord flies using this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rocket pack! Set in 1938 Los Angeles. [excited] And yes, he wears a cool finned helmet.

clues.clue: Besides flying, Pete's dragon friend Elliott has this special power.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is turning invisible! Handy when you're a dragon living in a small fishing town.
